description: Animations in an AnimationPlayer and states in an AnimationTree state machine. scene_node add puts the player or tree in the scene first, and autoplay is scene_node set. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: read (needs playerNodePath): the animations of a player, or one with its tracks in the shape add_track takes; read_states (needs animTreePath): the states and transitions of a state machine; create (needs playerNodePath, animationName): a new animation, and its library when the player lacks it; add_track (needs playerNodePath, animationName, track): a property or method track; remove_track (needs playerNodePath, animationName, track): every matching track, or some of its keys, and a track left with no key goes; set (needs playerNodePath, animationName): length, loop mode or step; rename (needs playerNodePath, animationName, newName): an animation, with what plays it; remove (needs playerNodePath, animationName): an animation, clearing the player's autoplay when it named it; add_state (needs animTreePath, stateName, animationName): a state playing an animation, written even when the player lacks it; remove_state (needs animTreePath, stateName): a state and its transitions; connect_states (needs animTreePath, fromState, toState); disconnect_states (needs animTreePath, fromState, toState).

advanceCondition.description: The condition parameter that advances it, parameters/conditions/<name>. Only with advanceMode auto. For op connect_states.

advanceMode.description: auto advances by itself, enabled only by travel(), disabled never. Default auto with advanceCondition or from Start, otherwise enabled. For op connect_states.

animTreePath.description: The AnimationTree node. For ops read_states, add_state, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

animationName.description: The animation, "walk" or "moves/walk" with its library. read: the one to answer whole, else all are listed. Not for ops read_states, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

fromState.description: The state the transition leaves. One from Start sets the first state. For ops connect_states, disconnect_states.

length.description: Seconds, more than 0. create: default 1. For ops create, set.

loopMode.description: create: default none. For ops create, set.

newName.description: The animation's new name. The player's autoplay and the states that play it follow. For op rename.

playerNodePath.description: The AnimationPlayer node. Not for ops read_states, add_state, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

replaceKeys.description: Put a keyframe in place of one at the same time. Default false, which refuses. For op add_track.

stateMachinePath.description: A nested state machine, by the names of the states that lead to it. Default the root. For ops read_states, add_state, remove_state, connect_states, disconnect_states.

stateName.description: The state to add, or to take out with its transitions. For ops add_state, remove_state.

step.description: Keyframe snap in seconds, 0 or more. create: default 0.1. For ops create, set.

times.description: Seconds of the keys to remove. The rest of the track stays. Default every key. For op remove_track.

toState.description: The state it arrives at. For ops connect_states, disconnect_states.

track.description: add_track: the track to add. remove_track: the track to take out, as read answers it. For ops add_track, remove_track.

interpolation.description: Default: linear, or as the RESET track. An existing track keeps its own.

keyframes.description: add_track: the keys, each at its own time.

transition.description: Property tracks: easing to the next key. Default 1.

loopWrap.description: Blend the last key into the first. Default true, or as the RESET track.

method.description: Method tracks: the method to call. A missing method or args that do not fit are written too, with methodFound or argumentsFit false. remove_track: only the keys calling it.

nodePath.description: Target node, relative to the AnimationPlayer's root_node. A property track also takes "Sprite2D:position" in place of property.

property.description: Property tracks: the property to animate.

type.description: add_track: property or method. remove_track: any of these types.

update.description: Default: as the RESET track, else continuous for a whole float, vector, colour or transform property, else discrete, position:x too.

transitionType.description: at_end waits for the state's animation to end, sync keeps the playback position. Default immediate. For op connect_states.

name: scene_animation
title: Animations
